findings.evidence: Rule check: 4 channel(s) not assigned to a sample: TMT132C, TMT133N, TMT133C, TMT134N. Description: "Four channels are unused."
findings.explanation: Only 12 of the 16 TMTpro channels are assigned to samples, which matches the description (12 samples in a 16-plex kit). The unused channels are probably empty by design. They should not be quantified as samples, and any signal in them is just background or isotopic impurity carryover.
findings.suggested_fix: No change to the SDRF is needed. Make sure the analysis excludes TMT132C, TMT133N, TMT133C and TMT134N, and note in the submission that they were left empty.

findings.evidence: Description: "RL cells (human diffuse large B-cell lymphoma cell line)" vs SDRF characteristics[disease]: "Burkitt lymphoma"
findings.explanation: The disease annotation contradicts the description, which says the RL cell line is a diffuse large B-cell lymphoma line. The SDRF says Burkitt lymphoma in every row.
findings.suggested_fix: Change characteristics[disease] to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in all rows, assuming the description is correct.

summary: The SDRF agrees with the description on organism, cell line, treatments, antibodies, trypsin, TMTpro and the 12-sample design. The one mismatch is the disease, which is Burkitt lymphoma in the SDRF but diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in the description. The four unused TMTpro channels match the description and need no correction.
